publishedDeadlines.label: IPIBS fellowship full consideration
publishedDeadlines.note: Central IPIBS annual fellowship consideration date; departmental rolling review continues through March.

english.note: Central IELTS minimum has no subscore below 5; PTE Academic 55 with no subscore below 53. Country/qualifying-degree exemptions apply; consult official policy and program-specific requirements.

requirements.note: Competitive candidates have GPA 3.0 overall and in sciences, prior research and strong letters. Fall-only rolling review December–March. Two letters is the Graduate School minimum; program page does not specify a higher number. A non-refundable application fee is required; amount not stated on opened central pages. Limited departmental fee waivers may be available case by case; international applicants should confirm eligibility.

funding.note: Selected IPIBS fellows receive support. Published undated IPIBS stipend $33,000, increasing to $35,000 after candidacy, tuition waiver and health insurance. Fellowship selection and continued support depend on program conditions.
